# Format-limited Precision Polygon

<div class="gc-badges">
<span class="gc-badge">vector</span><span class="gc-badge">GeoJSON</span><span class="gc-badge">Polygon</span><span class="gc-badge">EPSG:4326</span><span class="gc-badge">tiny</span><span class="gc-badge">bundled</span>
</div>

A very thin, valid polygon that relies on high coordinate precision to remain non-collapsed. It is valid in GeoJSON, but it is format-limited: precision rounding or driver-specific export constraints can collapse it into an invalid or zero-area geometry.

## What this case checks

Expose workflows that silently reduce coordinate precision and thereby invalidate geometries that are only safe in high-precision formats.

## Risk types covered

- `driver_specific_precision_loss`
- `format_limited`
- `precision_rounding`

## Expected behavior

| Assertion | Expected |
|---|---|
| `expect_loadable` | yes |
| `expect_valid_geometry` | yes |
| `expect_crs` | yes |
| `expected_epsg` | `4326` |
| `expected_geometry_types` | `Polygon` |

## Notes

Thin polygon that is valid in high-precision formats but vulnerable to rounding-induced collapse.
